A new DROP TABLE, DROP COLUMN, RENAME COLUMN or RENAME TO of a real table fails test/destructive-migrations.test.js until it is listed here with its contract step: the dated plan entry (section 10) that runs it after a release where nothing reads the old shape, with a backup. Temporary tables (_x, x_new, x_old, x_tmp) are not counted.
